events.summary: Jace tumbled down a waterfall and plunged deep into his past.
events.quote: Jace tumbled down the waterfall and plunged deep into his past.

events.summary: Bolas remade a place in his image, giving him the advantage there.
events.quote: "Bolas remade this place in his image. He has the advantage here. We must approach carefully."

events.summary: Sorin Markov tells Ugin he lies entombed with the corpses of worlds to join him.
events.quote: "Here you lie then, Ugin. The corpses of worlds will join you in the tomb."

events.summary: Domri's spark was harvested, and the Elderspell began to fuel Bolas's ascension to godhood.
events.quote: With the harvest of Domri's spark, the Elderspell began to fuel Bolas's ascension to godhood.

events.summary: Sheoldred predicts that many worlds will bow to Phyrexia, with Mirrodin first.
events.quote: "I believe many worlds will bow to Phyrexia. Mirrodin is merely the first."

events.summary: Nissa Revane tells Dwynen she has already seen too much evil and darkness.
events.quote: "I've already seen so much evil, so much darkness. Why do you insist on adding more?"

events.summary: Multani's body was rebuilt by rage.
events.quote: Multani's mind grasped for consciousness as rage itself rebuilt his body.

events.summary: Garruk Wildspeaker confronts Liliana Vess in a dark plane.
events.quote: I have taken down countless night hunters. This dark plane is not big enough for you to hide.

events.summary: After Gideon cleansed the Ninth District, no ganglords challenged the Boros.
events.quote: After Gideon cleansed the Ninth District, none of the ganglords challenged the Boros.

events.summary: Wyleth emerged from a crater unscathed holding the sun's fury.
events.quote: Wyleth emerged from the crater unscathed with the sun's fury trapped in his hands.

events.summary: After the Battle of Liet Field, the white sun crested above Taj-Nar bringing hope.
events.quote: After the Battle of Liet Field, the white sun crested above Taj-Nar, bringing hope to all who survived the carnage.

relations.note: Multani speaks of his child Muldrotha
relations.quote: "My child grew from rot and ruin, yet she bloomed."
